decisions.reason: Coolant pressure booster systems complement the firm's coolant and chip management portfolio for machine tools and carry low ongoing cost once introduced.
Coolant cleaning centrifuges meet growing demand for coolant life extension and sustainability, so keeping this product fits a large equipment maker's systems offering.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost accessory that supports cross-selling with the booster systems and conveyors.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a standard core product in chip management with steady demand from machine tool builders.
Magnetic belt chip conveyors serve fine ferrous chip applications and round out the conveyor range at little extra cost.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are the workhorse conveyor type, and dropping them would leave a gap in the core portfolio.
